dedupe_keys.name: wind tunnel testing of wind loads on large format tilted photovoltaic pv modules on flat roofs

description: Wind-Tunnel Testing of Wind Loads on Large-Format Tilted Photovoltaic (PV) Modules on Flat Roofs is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ioannis Zisis, Florida International University (fiu.edu). This project contains wind-tunnel experimental data and supporting analysis materials for wind loads on large-format tilted photovoltaic (PV) modules installed on flat roofs. The experiments were conducted at the NHERI Wall of Wind Experimental Facility at Florida International University using a 1:20-scale low-rise flat-roof building model. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: wind loads, photovoltaic modules, flat roofs, wind tunnel testing, rooftop PV systems, wind-induced pressures. Published 2026-05-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
